goldForScorerOnly.use: offline diagnostic on the 96 targets only

evaluationLabel: Development canary: program-read evidence in the request, on segments chosen from earlier errors; Stage 1 only; not an F1 estimate
instruction:
Trích xuất tất cả các heading thực sự tổ chức cấu trúc tài liệu, xét theo vai trò của từng lần xuất hiện tại chính vị trí đó.
Chọn những dòng hoặc nhóm dòng có chức năng đặt tên, mở đầu hoặc phân chia một phần nội dung của tài liệu.
Không chọn các dòng trong mục lục chỉ liệt kê hoặc dẫn chiếu đến heading xuất hiện ở vị trí khác. Tuy nhiên, vẫn xem xét các heading thực sự tổ chức chính mục lục, chỉ mục và những phần khác của tài liệu.
Sử dụng văn bản, bố cục và ngữ cảnh để xác định chức năng của từng lần xuất hiện. Khi chưa đủ bằng chứng, hãy yêu cầu thêm ngữ cảnh hoặc báo chưa thể quyết định thay vì suy đoán.

whyThisPlan.observed: Over three consumed campaigns (D4.11b c50833bb, D4.11f a57d260f, D4.11g 41376cd2) Qwen emitted 0 tool calls in 12 of 12 requests, with a tool-first instruction, a procedural prompt, SSE, reasoning enabled and response_format removed on the tool turns. Its reasoning says no tool call is needed because the information is sufficient.
whyThisPlan.selections: SEG-001 AUTO selected the same 46 contents lines (pages 2 and 3, none Gold; 44 of them have another occurrence in the document that is a Gold heading) in D4.10 arm B, D4.11f and D4.11g, and none in D4.11b: 46, 0, 46, 46 on near-identical requests.
whyThisPlan.change: The program reads the evidence itself and puts it in the request, instead of waiting for the model to ask. This no longer tests whether Qwen calls tools; it tests whether evidence, once in front of Qwen, changes what it selects.
whyThisPlan.precedent: F1Q payloads already carried a program-computed repeated-text hint (correspondences) in every occurrence of the Issue #5 experiment.

controlIdentity.rule: The CONTROL first requests must equal the D4.11g AUTO first requests of plan 41376cd2 byte for byte (same prompt text, same payload, same envelope); checked by the plan and by a test.

prefetch.rule: A target is listed if its normalized text (the repeat normalization of get_repeated_occurrences) also occurs on another line of the document. That is the only criterion: nothing says what any line is.
prefetch.shows: for each listed target: how many other occurrences and on how many pages; for the first 2 other occurrences in reading order: alias, page, reading-order position and distance from the target, whether the text is exactly the same (the text itself when it differs), layout, differences in font size, bold ratio and left edge (other minus target), and the line that follows it

caps.overflow: cut to 1 other occurrence per target, then by whole targets from the end; the object says so (complete false, omittedTargets)

prefetch.whereInRequest: the last property of the user payload, after targets and context; every byte before it equals the CONTROL payload
prefetch.promptLine: one added line (PREFETCH prompt SHA differs from CONTROL by that line only) saying the observations are facts read by the program, not labels, that evidenceRefs may cite the aliases they show, and when a target not listed has no other occurrence
prefetch.notSharedWithAnyAnswer: the observations come from the parser only; Gold and earlier answers are never used

repetitions.requests: identical bytes each time, so the spread is sampling variation of the same request
repetitions.order: per repetition, per segment: CONTROL then PREFETCH

frozen.scope: SRC-095 only: the runner rebuilds the universe from the pinned PDF and refuses any other document, source hash or universe hash; the plan is re-derived from code and source and any drift refuses the run

provider.endpointCheck: response provider must be Alibaba and model qwen/qwen3.7-flash, else the run halts

frozen.laterTurns: turn 2 onward are built from the first request plus Qwen's own tool calls and the tool results; their bodies are stored with the run

tools.availability: declared in both arms, optional (tool_choice auto on turns 1 to 3, none on turn 4)

toolResultCache: per unit, in memory, as in plan 41376cd2 (repeats return the stored result and say so; counted in full toward the byte cap; never shared between units or arms)
promptCache: telemetry only: cached_tokens, cache_write_tokens and cache_discount are read from each response when present; no cache_control, no session_id, no response caching
requestShape: SSE (stream true), reasoning enabled true, response_format absent on turns 1 to 3 and json_object on turn 4, temperature 0, max_tokens 32768, usage include; the strict parser refuses any final answer that is not exactly one JSON object
zdr: false (owner decision, to be accepted again in the authorization)
stages: SELECT, stage SEGMENT only; no RESOLVE, FINALIZE or GROUP

budget.perArm: each arm has its own budget and early stop; totals are the sum
budget.ifToolsAreCalled: each arm has 24 posts, the most its 6 units can use (4 each), so the call limit cannot stop a unit; the dollar ceiling is the worst-case reserve of 24 posts at the byte cap, a bound and not the expected spend (the earlier requests cost about $0.001 to $0.0012 each)
budget.raisedFrom: 9 posts and $0.25 per arm (18 posts, $0.50) in plan b76a2c7e, by the owner's permission to exceed the budget; nothing else in the plan changed

measurements: primary, per arm and repetition: SEG-001 selected lines, and how many are Gold (Gold has none among the 48 targets); SEG-008 selected lines against the 1 Gold atom (tp, fp, fn)
the spread of those numbers across the 3 repetitions of one arm, against the difference between the arms
which lines were selected: whether the 44 contents lines that have a Gold heading elsewhere are still selected, and whether the 2 running-header lines stay unselected

whether an answer cites an alias that only the observations show (EvidenceUsedFromObservations), and whether the reasoning mentions the observations (counts only; the reasoning is never used to change an answer)
tool calls per arm (any), invalid and rejected calls, cache hits
protocol outcome per unit; parse failures are reported with their code, never repaired; a fence counterfactual is offline and not official
tokens and cost per request, reasoning tokens, observation bytes
readingRules: 3 repetitions per cell: an indication, not a significance test
PREFETCH selects clearly fewer SEG-001 contents lines than CONTROL, beyond the spread inside each arm, and keeps SEG-008: the evidence changes the decision
PREFETCH selects the same lines as CONTROL: Qwen is shown that the text occurs elsewhere and still selects it, so the cause is not missing evidence of that kind
PREFETCH loses the SEG-008 heading or selects other lines: the observations disturb the decision, to be examined before any use
CONTROL differs between its own repetitions: the same request is unstable, which bounds what any single run shows
rawPublication: Raw SSE responses (reasoning included), request bodies, run summaries and the analysis stay in the safe store outside the repository. They are copied into the repository (d411-publish) and pushed only if the approving message says to push them.

comparedCampaigns.note: its AUTO first requests are the CONTROL arm of this plan
